info.description: One human-readable section per content type, generated once and shared by every account. Rows are never served whole: the brief is assembled per caller from the sections that caller's own permissions allow them to read.

locale.description: Which language version this section's counts are of. Null for sections written before language versions were tracked — which means exactly that, and NEVER 'all of them'.

pageInformed.description: Whether rendered-page analysis informed this section, so an operator can tell the two kinds of section apart and re-run one without the other.

pageUrl.description: The page that was read, or null. Recorded for the same reason pageInformed is.

pageLocale.description: Which language version of the page was read, or null when the front end could not distinguish one.
